{{Recipe summary
| Category = Cookie recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] ground [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]] or [[Cookbook:Almond Flour|almond meal]]
* 250 g white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 1–2 drops [[Cookbook:Almond Extract|almond essence]]
* [[Cookbook:Vanilla|Vanilla essence]]
* Whole almonds for decoration
* [[Cookbook:Wafer Paper|Rice paper]]

==Procedure==

# Combine ground almonds, sugar, lemon juice, and almond essence in a bowl.
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites until stiff, then add to the almond mixture. Mix well to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# Lay rice paper on flat baking dish.
# Place a tablespoon of the dough in your palm and roll it into a small ball. Place on rice paper, and flatten slightly.
# Repeat the shaping process with the remaining dough.
# Press an almond into the top of each cookie, and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 375°F for 25 minutes or until light golden brown.
